name: apps
description: Drive the Mac's apps from the Capsule, the CLI and the phone: Clock timers and alarms, notes, reminders, the weather, Slack and WhatsApp. Actions that send as the person go through apps.send, with a proof per call (WhatsApp, through the hands), or are held at the Gate for the person to approve (Slack).

tips.text: Type `timer 10 min` in the Capsule and press `⏎`. It is set at once, with no app to open.
Run `vyre apps setup clock` once so Vyre can set timers and alarms in the Mac's Clock.
Run `vyre apps note: call Northwind Bakery on Friday` to jot a note without leaving the terminal.
Messages show before they go: type `whatsapp juno: running late`, press `⏎` to check, `⏎` again to send.
Type `@Notes` and your words to make a note of them, no keyword needed.
Add `in Apple Clock` to a timer to ring the Mac's Clock. Without it, the Planner keeps the timer on every device.
Type `weather tomorrow` in the Capsule, or run `vyre apps weather tomorrow`, for the forecast.
Run `vyre apps` to list the apps on this Mac and how Vyre reaches each one.
